message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Location | Pet Policy | Notes | |---------|----------|------------|-------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (Miami Central Station)** | 1 Seaboard Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | **Pets allowed** – Amtrak, Tri‑Rail, and Metrorail all permit pets in carriers (and some allow small dogs on the train). The station itself is pet‑friendly: there are no restrictions on pets in the waiting areas, and the station’s elevators and escalators are accessible to service animals. | • Serves Amtrak (Florida East Coast & Silver Service), Tri‑Rail (regional commuter), and Metrorail (subway).
• Parking: 24‑hour parking with a pet‑friendly zone (no extra fee).
• Amenities: restrooms, vending machines, Wi‑Fi, and a small café. | ### How to Use the Station with a Pet 1. **On the Train** - **Amtrak**: Pets must be in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area. Small dogs may travel for free; larger pets require a fee. - **Tri‑Rail**: Pets in carriers are allowed on all trains. No additional fee. - **Metrorail**: Pets are allowed on the train but must be in a carrier or on a leash. No fee. 2. **At the Station** - Pets are welcome in the waiting areas. - Service animals are permitted in all areas. - There are no special pet‑specific facilities (e.g., pet wash stations), but the station’s open layout makes it easy to move around with a leash. 3. **Contact Information** - **Phone**: (305) 284‑4000 (Miami Intermodal Center) - **Website**: [miamiintermodalcenter.com](https://miamiintermodalcenter.com) – check the “Travel” section for pet policies on each rail service. ### Quick Tips - **Carrier Size**: Make sure your pet’s carrier meets the size limits for the specific rail service (usually 18 in × 14 in × 12 in for Amtrak). - **Documentation**: Keep a copy of your pet’s vaccination records handy in case a staff member asks. - **Arrival Time**: Arrive at least 30 minutes early to give yourself time to navigate the station with your pet. If you need a different station (e.g., the Miami Airport station), let me know and I can check its pet policy for you!
